page.notes: Marginal line numbers 10, 20, 30, 40 and 50 stand in the left margin beside their lines; they are line counts, not page numbers. Long s rendered as s. Some words in the bracketed group are set in tight columns and their exact line division is approximate. Left margin bracket group and right-side bracket note are reconstructed from the printed layout; the bottom-left fragment "in Faltis, Suetonius, Macro-" belongs to the left-margin note group. The line "Plu-" ends the page with a signature mark "Sff 3" at the foot, not transcribed as text. Some letters in the Greek-less right-column notes are uncertain.
